releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.30

- Cloud sync works again. The last two updates were built without their Firebase
  settings, so sync was switched off in the app itself and signing in was not
  even offered. Online subtitle search and Sign in with Google were disabled the
  same way. All three are back.
- Updates no longer leave the downloaded installer behind. Each update used to
  keep its full 65 MB file in the app's storage, invisibly, forever.
- Tapping Update twice no longer starts a second download or interrupts the one
  already running.
